name: crepe-pose
status: experiment, not used by any pipeline, the robot or the team's results
description: Crepe mask and position from one rectified frame. Challenge task 2. A local experiment, not a shipped model.
estimator: small U-Net with a direction head, in PyTorch

mask.meaning: crepe probability per pixel. Threshold 0.5, then keep the largest region with holes filled. The centre is the mask centroid.

direction.meaning: unproven fold direction. Do not use.

host.note: Apple M4 Pro laptop, not the robot

latency.pi5_estimate_method: single-thread total x 4 to x 8. The repo's rough x 4 is for an x86 laptop core and an M4 core is likely faster, so the top end is a judgement. Not measured on a Raspberry Pi 5.

chain: 6,000 synthetic images: real plates, 75% real cut-outs
fine-tuned on robot overlay outlines, training split
fine-tuned on reviewed hand masks, all five labelled runs

hand_masks.source: private labels repo, with an update not merged there

hand_masks_held_out.reference: reviewed hand masks, may be pixel-assisted
hand_masks_held_out.method: each fold trains on four runs, scores the fifth
hand_masks_held_out.note: folds, not the final model: it trained on all five

unseen_check_frames.reference: robot overlay outline, not ground truth

generalization_reason: Hand masks cover one robot, there is no leave-one-robot-out check and maus-otto has only 6 unseen frames.
missing: bootstrap intervals for the final model
any measurement on a Raspberry Pi 5
robustness tests for real steam and light changes
caveats: Can mark a hand or sleeve as crepe.
False crepes on 4 of 80 empty plates in the held-out folds.
Hand masks come from one robot and may start from suggestions.
Scores used the slower full-size warp. The fast warp scored median IoU 0.962 vs 0.964 on 79 unseen frames, chosen on them.
Fixed batch of 1: frames must be run one at a time.
Check-frame scores use the robot's outline as the reference.
All hand-labelled runs are in the shared test split.
Needs a rectification transform for the run to read a frame.
out_of_scope: fold angle: direction never beat the training average, and hand fine-tuning did not train it
holes: they are filled in the mask
commit_note: trained on a local branch that was later squashed
